summary.headline: Laurentian Manuscripts of Vettius Valens
summary.text: Editorial discussion of Laurentianus 28,20 and Laurentianus 86,18, comparing their relationship to Venetus 3 and describing Laurentianus 86,18’s fuller readings of Vettius Valens on the zodiacal signs. It cites the Capricorn, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, and Sagittarius chapters, possible dependence on Hephaestion, and Regiomontanus’s Greek manuscript and 1532 Latin excerpts from the Anthologies.
